Name: Scythe Tool Enchantments
Author: mushymato
Description:
[b][size=4]New Enchantments
[/size][/b]

[b][color=#93c47d]Gatherer[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]50% chance to get 1 more fiber when cutting weeds[/size]
[*][size=3]50% chance to get 1 more hay when cutting grass[/size]
[*][size=3]50% chance to get 1 more moss from trees.[/size]
[/list][size=3]Increase number of basic resources gained, a tweaked version of haymaker from vanilla.
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26220]Custom Moss[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url].


[b][color=#c27ba0]Horticulturist[/color][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Get 1 more flower (normal quality) when harvesting flower crops. No effect on forage seeds.[/size]
[/list][size=3]Increase the profitability of flowers as a crop, great for mods that add more flowers and flower based artisan goods.


[b][color=#bf9000]Palaeontologist[/color]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]50% chance to get 1 bone fragment from cutting weeds or grass[/size]
[*][size=3]5% to get 1 random fossil from cutting weeds or grass[/size]
[/list][size=3]Get fuel for the bone mill from weeds and grass, a more specialised version of the Archaeologist enchantment.


[b][color=#cc4125]Reaper[/color][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Increase overall attack power of the scythe*[/size]
[*][size=3]Monsters killed with scythe drop extra loot, stacks with other loot drop increase effects.[/size]
[/list][size=3]Turns the scythe into a viable melee weapon, while keeping the harvest tool theme through buffing drop rate.
A scythe with this enchantment still CANNOT get forged, this is intentional.

*Scythe stats after enchantment is calculated based on the Infinity Blade:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Min and max damage is set to 3/4 of min damage on infinity blade[/size]
[*][size=3]Critical chance is set to half of the infinity blade [/size]
[*][size=3]Weapon speed is set to that of the infinity blade[/size]
[*][size=3]Iridium scythe has innate +50 critical damage, which is unchanged[/size]
[/list][size=3]This means that a iridium scythe with reaper is more powerful if used with mods that buff the infinity blade, such as [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][size=3]SVE[/size][/url][size=3]﻿.[/size]


[color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Great Crescent
[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3]Your scythe swings in a wide arc.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can harvest giant crops.[/size]
[/list][size=3]Scythe version of reaching, maximum crop harvest efficiency.


[b][size=4]Configuration
[/size][/b][size=3]Scythe enchantments are acquired by [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Forge#Enchantments]forging[/url] an iridium scythe with a prismatic shard, just like other tool enchantments. The enchantment you get is randomised following the same rules too.
[/size]
[size=3]You can prevent certain scythe enchantments from appearing via configuration file or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. This has no effect on currently applied enchantments.
[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for in game mod configs.﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8824]Many Enchantments[/url]﻿: Can have all 5 enchantments on 1 scythe.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10668]Enchantable Scythes And Golden Scythe Respawns[/url]: Should not use together with this mod, both mods change enchantment logic related to scythes.﻿[/size]
[/list]
[b]Translations[/b]
[/size]
[list]

[/list][size=3]
